extracted.intended_audience: clinical trial investigators, trial methodologists, journal editors, and authors preparing trial protocols and reports
extracted.subtask_description: Identify and apply the appropriate SPIRIT or CONSORT extension when reporting non-standard randomized trial designs, specific data types, or particular intervention types; the page lists published extensions and the materials available for each. Useful for authors, editors, and developers of new extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicability of SPIRIT/CONSORT extensions
rubrics_metrics.description: The main SPIRIT and CONSORT Statements are based on the 'standard' two-group parallel design; extensions/modifications apply to trials with variations in design, interventions, or data (e.g., cluster designs, non-pharmacological interventions, harms).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use a relevant extension to improve reporting when the trial departs from the standard two-group parallel design; review the extension policy and register interest for developing new extensions.
